title: PRD-09 synthetic risk input syntax

annuitantRef.description: required; authorized insured/member relationship. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: ANNUITANT_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

birthDate.description: required; valid nonfuture date. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: BIRTH_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

contributionAmount.description: required; positive exact integer amount. Sensitivity: financial. Error: CONTRIBUTION_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

contributionTermCode.description: required; offered term <= 40 characters. Sensitivity: financial. Error: TERM_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

payoutOptionCode.description: required; contract-supported benefit option. Sensitivity: financial. Error: PAYOUT_OPTION_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

plannedStartDate.description: required; explicit local-date semantics; eligibility from contract. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: START_DATE_INELIGIBLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

illustrationVersion.description: required for benefit display; approved version <= 80. Sensitivity: financial. Error: BENEFIT_ILLUSTRATION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
